# The worker already owns a genuine claim. _check_source above revalidates
 # that same claim using ResearchRun's original _own_claim path; a second
 # fresh admission would correctly refuse the already spent identity.
 from ..admission import Admission
 ad=run.admission
 require(type(ad)is Admission and ad.ready is True,'genuine ready existing admission unavailable')
 require(Path(args.root).resolve()==ad.root and args.registration==ad.registration and args.experiment==ad.experiment_id and args.source==ad.source,'actual args/existing Run admission differs')
 require(ad.design_source==ad.source and ad.bindings is None and ad.bindings_sha256 is None,'original job source/design binding differs')
 if 'execution_workspace' in ad.inputs:
  layout=ad.inputs['execution_workspace'];raw=run.read_input('execution_workspace')
  require(sha(raw)==layout['sha256'] and json.loads(raw)==job.workspace_binding(ad.root),'registered execution workspace/ledger/artifact mapping differs')
 raw=run.read_input('execution_job')
 require(sha(raw)==ad.inputs['execution_job']['sha256'],'execution job bytes differ')
 j=json.loads(raw);job.job_schema(j);job.resource_policy(j['resources'],ad.root)
 require(job.required_sources()<=set(ad.experiment['source_files']),'execution dependency source closure not registered')
 require(Path(job.__file__).resolve()==ad.root/(PREFIX+'job.py'),'execution imported from outside admitted source root')
 p=admitted(ad,j)
